summary: Converted web search and artifact generation to OpenAI-style model-initiated tool calls: new app/llm/tools.py (TOOL_SCHEMAS, available_tools, ToolContext-free executor execute_tool), stream_chat gained tools mode with structured SSE events {type:delta|tool_call} and a retry-without-tools fallback on 400 'tool' errors, turn.py replaced the unconditional pre-search with a max-4-iteration agentic loop emitting tool_call/tool_result events and attaching actions+web_sources to done, system prompt gained TOOL_HINT, FakeLLM gained tool scripting, plus offline tests.
final_report:
T45 done. Model-initiated tool calls shipped across four modules plus fakes/tests.

WHAT CHANGED
1. app/llm/tools.py (NEW, 155 lines): TOOL_SCHEMAS as OpenAI function dicts for web_search{query}, generate_mermaid{topic}, generate_quiz{topic,count 1..10}, generate_todo{topic}, generate_latex{topic}, record_step_actions{actions[1..6] of id-enum/label<=60/prompt<=200}; available_tools(settings) gates web_search on settings.searxng_url, always includes the other five; async execute_tool(name,args,ctx) dispatches - web_search lazily imports search_web with max_results=min(5,context_chunk_budget), filters wikidiff/redkiwiapp urls (moved from turn.py), returns {results:[{title,url,snippet}]}; generate_* builds one-shot [system=make_system_prompt, user='Generate ONLY the JSON for output_kind=...'] then complete_json -> parse_exact_json -> validate_output, quiz enforces count (quiz_count code), mermaid runs validate_mermaid for diagram_type, returns validated model_dump()+kind; errors return {'error': <existing issue code>} via _issue_code mapping (issue_codes first entry -> pydantic error type -> known-code prefix else invalid_output); record_step_actions validates TeachActionDraft list, rejects >6/dup ids/bad enum. ctx is duck-typed (no import of turn.py).
2. app/llm/client.py: stream_chat(..., tools=None). tools=None keeps the exact legacy string-delta contract. With tools, yields dict events: {type:'delta',delta} through the same thought scrubber (extracted verbatim into _ThoughtScrubber feed/flush state machine; _strip_thought never touches arguments) and one {type:'tool_call',id,name,arguments(parsed-or-raw),raw_tool_calls,assistant_content} per accumulated call when finish_reason=='tool_calls' or stream ends with pending calls, then stops consuming. _open_stream centralizes create(); on APIStatusError 400 containing 'tool' it logs 'tools unsupported by endpoint; retrying without tools' and retries once without tools. _next_chunk leak fix untouched.
3. app/llm/messages.py: added TOOL_HINT to make_system_prompt telling the model to call web_search/generate_*/record_step_actions instead of fabricating outputs as text.
4. turn.py: pre-search block and _BASIC_PATTERNS deleted entirely; trees hint kept; messages built with build_chat_messages(...) (no web_results); agentic loop max 4 iterations (_MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS) streams llm.stream_chat(messages, tools=None if mode=='strict' else available_tools(settings)) - string items adapted to delta events so legacy fakes keep working; on tool_call: yields SSE tool_call, executes via execute_tool, appends ONE assistant echo (raw_tool_calls) per response plus role:'tool' message with json.dumps(result), yields tool_result with summary (web_search titles+urls list / mermaid 'kind ok' / 'N actions' / 'error: code') and for generate_mermaid also kind,title,source,diagram_type so the UI can render the card; record_step_actions stashed into done.actions; web urls collected into done.web_sources. meta event now carries web_sources:[] up front (urls land on done because search executes after meta was already sent - single-meta-per-turn design choice, flagged for review). Persist/citations/GenerationCancelled/ProviderError handling unchanged.
5. tests/fakes/fake_llm.py: stream_chat accepts tools; script_tool_events scripts one-shot tool_call/delta sequences (emitting wire-format raw_tool_calls); without a script it falls back to scripted-text word deltas preserving fail_after/cancel emulation in both string and dict modes.
6. tests/test_tools_loop.py (NEW): 9 tests covering available_tools gating, full turn loop order meta->tool_call->tool_result->delta*->done with executor-query/wikidiff-filter/role-tool follow-up assertions, record_step_actions stash->done.actions, generate_mermaid card fields via monkeypatched validator, execute_tool mermaid unit path (validate_fn injection, fenced source normalization, diagram_type), quiz_count mismatch, bad-id invalid_action rejection, LLMClient 400-'tools' fallback (two create calls, second without tools, warning logged), and plain-path string contract.

VERIFICATION
python -m compileall app tests OK. Target suites: tests/test_tools_loop.py 9/9, tests/test_api_chat_sse.py 12/13, tests/test_thought_filter.py 5/5, tests/test_llm_client.py pass. Full suite 345 passed / 4 failed; ALL four failures are the documented oc-issues #34 environment class (repo .env BROT_API_KEY leaks into Settings because field-name init kwargs do not beat aliased .env values): test_turn_rejects_missing_config plus test_probe_config_missing_400, test_plan_config_missing_400, test_notes_quiz_endpoint_config_missing_400 - re-ran the latter three with BROT_API_KEY cleared and all pass, proving they are environmental, not caused by this diff.

DEVIATIONS / NOTES FOR REVIEWERS
a) tools.py landed at 155 lines vs the <150 target: black's one-item-per-line expansion of six JSON-schema literals sets that floor; I chose readability over name-golfing (ToolContext moved next to its only consumer in turn.py; schema table data-driven; no dead helpers left).
b) web_sources appears empty on meta and populated on done (search executes after meta is emitted); spec said 'meta event' - interpreted as stable-schema key up front + populated terminal event alongside actions.
c) Assistant echo appended once per response even with parallel tool calls; each call gets its own role:'tool' message keyed by call id.
d) tools.py execute_tool catches all exceptions into {'error': code} so the loop always continues and the model can self-correct within the 4-iteration cap; iteration exhaustion persists buffered content as today.
e) No commit made per task instruction; working tree at start carried the uncommitted T40 batch which this change stacks on and preserves (_next_chunk leak fix verified untouched).

Merlin should verify: live provider tool-call round trip against ollama.com/v1 (gemma4 native function calling per T30 research), SSE wire shape of tool_call/tool_result events, fallback path against an endpoint without tools support, and UI consumption of done.actions/web_sources and the mermaid card fields.
